sides.text: A web tier calls a processing tier; spikes overwhelm processing. Which change decouples them?
options: Insert an SQS queue between them

sides.text: A. Insert an SQS queue between them

more.text: Queues buffer bursts and decouple scaling.

sides.text: Which service fans out a message to many subscribers?
B. Amazon SNS
An SQS consumer takes 120 seconds per message, and messages are processed twice. What fix?
C. Increase the visibility timeout

more.text: The timeout must exceed processing time.

sides.text: Which load balancer routes by URL path?
D. Application Load Balancer
Which is the lowest-cost DR strategy?
A. Backup and restore

more.text: RPO and RTO are in hours.

sides.text: RDS must survive an AZ failure automatically. Which feature?
B. Multi-AZ deployment

more.text: A synchronous standby fails over automatically.

sides.text: Which service coordinates multiple Lambda functions with retries and branches?
C. AWS Step Functions
What routes users to a standby Region when the primary fails health checks?
D. Route 53 failover routing
A legacy app cannot be changed but needs higher availability. Which approach?
options: Auto Scaling group of one behind a load balancer with a shared EFS or RDS Multi-AZ

sides.text: A. Auto Scaling group of one behind a load balancer with a shared EFS or RDS Multi-AZ
Which service pools database connections for Lambda?
B. Amazon RDS Proxy

more.text: Reduces connection storms and speeds failover.

sides.text: Which statement is true about RDS read replicas?
C. They use asynchronous replication

more.text: Replicas scale reads; Multi-AZ provides HA.

sides.text: An RPO of seconds and RTO of under a minute with a large budget. Which strategy?
D. Multi-site active-active
Which feature trace requests across microservices?
A. AWS X-Ray
Which compute option runs containers without managing servers?
B. AWS Fargate
An application stores sessions on instances and cannot scale out. What fix?
options: Store sessions in ElastiCache or DynamoDB

sides.text: C. Store sessions in ElastiCache or DynamoDB
Which service provides managed RabbitMQ for migrating existing apps?
D. Amazon MQ
What happens to an SQS message that fails repeatedly when a dead-letter queue is configured?
options: It moves to the DLQ after the max receives

sides.text: A. It moves to the DLQ after the max receives
Which Aurora feature replicates across Regions with typical lag under a second?
options: RDS read replica in the same Region

sides.text: B. Aurora Global Database
Which deployment strategy provides instant rollback by swapping environments?
C. Blue/green

more.text: Switch traffic back to the old environment.

sides.text: DynamoDB data must be available in two Regions with active writes in both. Which feature?
D. Global tables
What is the maximum Lambda runtime per invocation?
A. 15 minutes

more.text: Longer jobs use Step Functions, Batch, or containers.

sides.text: Which service delivers static anycast IPs and routes over the AWS backbone for TCP traffic?
B. AWS Global Accelerator
Two independent 99% available components in parallel give what availability?
Which feature automatically replaces failed EC2 instances in a group?
D. EC2 Auto Scaling health checks

more.text: Unhealthy instances are terminated and replaced.

sides.text: Which service queues messages and guarantees order and exactly-once processing?
A. SQS FIFO
